task_description: Adversarial two-round review of Taskfleet ADR 0002 R8 integrated pre-cut validation evidence, including a context-request follow-up and verification of evidence-harness corrections.
notes: The panel converged from strong initial objections to pass-after-finalization. OpenAI explicitly retracted a false Ruby quoted-label blocker. Anthropic and DeepSeek found the strongest late-stage fail-closed and isolation gaps.

rows.strength: Found wrapper-install, stress-wording, and platform-boundary questions and corrected the false Ruby claim.
rows.weakness: Accepted finalization too quickly and once claimed the indexed sanitizer was missing without verifying the supplied update.

rows.strength: Found the aggregate authorization weakness, missing raw logs, symlink checks, cache isolation, verify-mode bug, and parity normalization gap.
rows.weakness: Initially raised a blocking Ruby String/Symbol claim that was factually wrong, though it retracted it explicitly after challenge.

rows.strength: Caught CI-count interpretation, stale machine authority, commit-unbound residue, exception handling, and finalization ordering with strong nuance.
rows.weakness: At times treated explicit owner disposition as requiring an additional waiver loop after the user had already defined diagnostic handling.

rows.strength: Caught stale DAG contradiction, exact-once warning coverage, post-update Homebrew identity, and the host RUSTUP_HOME isolation gap.
rows.weakness: Occasionally elevated stale generated evidence to product-level severity before checking its disposition.
